people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
translations.bsb: the Lord will surely bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates — the king of Assyria and all his pomp. It will overflow its channels and overrun its banks.
translations.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
